questions.stem: During pulmonary function testing, a 52-year-old smoker inspires a normal breath and then expires completely into the spirometer, expelling a measured volume of air. In a second test, the patient inspires maximally and then expires completely into the spirometer, expelling a second measured volume of air. By subtracting the volume of air obtained in the first test from the volume of air obtained in the second test, it is possible to determine which of the following?
